profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer/ ETL at Steel Technologies

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer/ ETL
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
	Create and maintain EDI Maps
	Create and maintain Business Processes related to order to shipment
	Maintain various communication protocols:
o	FTP
o	FTP/S
o	HTTP/S
o	AS2
	Support e-Commerce with various large corporations
	SME for EDI related projects
	Liaison between Business Analysts, and Software engineers, some of which are located in Pune, India
	Maintain existing data dictionary
	Configure new data connections
	Troubleshooting data issues
	Support existing legacy applications while simultaneously implementing new business requests utilizing the organization’s newer toolset
	Analysis and Design  
o	Demonstrates expertise across one business application and multiple technical platforms
o	Acts as a designer for production support changes and/or enhancements
o	Understands the business requirements or collects additional data
o	Looks for way to improve and/or optimize business processes to prevent reoccurring issues
	Quality Control  
o	Ensures that quality control standards are met for support solutions
o	Writes user manuals and provides user training where applicable
o	Develops detailed system change specification where applicable
o	Provide testing for solutions implemented
	Project Management
o	Manages work via tickets and is responsible for deliverables.
o	Document solutions for future reference and tracking.

positions.title: Midrange Services Supervisor
positions.description: As the Midrange Services Supervisor I was responsible for managing a team of five.  My role was to work with the business community to implement best practices as it relates to rolling out functional and technical solutions in a Power 7 (i-Series) environment.

positions.title: IT Program Manager
positions.description:
As an IT Program Manager I was responsible for:
•	The deployment of IT applications to the business community
•	Software implementations, requirements gathering, system analysis, and functional design
•	Liaison between the business and IT for the purpose of scoping out business requirements
•	Working with IT development in an Agile environment 
•	Facilitating application training with business community and customers
•	Ensuring solutions are aligned with business needs and objectives
•	Oversaw the e-Commerce and EDI environments (Trusted Link/GXS)
•	Business contact for EDI related issues
•	Supporting the Infor XA (MAPICS) application

positions.title: EDI Manager
positions.description:
As an EDI manager in the Data Group I was responsible for:
•	Managing the EDI area to ensure the reliability of data being sent to and from our customers and suppliers
•	Analyzing business requests and their impact to business and integrated systems
•	Performing technical reviews
•	Interviewing business owners to determine business objectives and criteria for success 
•	Meeting with IT development teams to communicate business requests and operational improvements
•	Identifying gaps between current applications and future requirements

positions.title: Senior EDI Analyst
positions.description: As a Senior EDI Analyst for E.D.S. I was responsible for maintaining Steel Technologies’ EDI environment.
